name: IBM watsonx.ai
tagline: Enterprise foundation-model inference with IBM governance tooling.
description: IBM watsonx.ai is a platform for building and deploying AI applications using foundation models, with enterprise-grade governance, security, and compliance features. It provides REST APIs for model inference, fine-tuning, and management of AI assets, integrated with IBM Cloud services.

auth.details: IBM Cloud IAM bearer token via Authorization: Bearer header. Obtain token using API key with IAM token endpoint (https://iam.cloud.ibm.com/identity/token).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Lite plan with limited monthly capacity (varies by model; check IBM Cloud catalog). Free trial credits often available for new accounts.
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go based on tokens processed; enterprise plans available. Pricing varies by model and region.

example.request: curl -X POST "https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com/ml/v1/text/generation?version=2024-05-31" -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: application/json" -d '{"model_id": "ibm/granite-13b-chat-v2", "input": "Hello", "parameters": {"max_new_tokens": 50}, "project_id": "YOUR_PROJECT_ID"}'
example.response_snippet: {"model_id": "ibm/granite-13b-chat-v2", "created_at": "2024-...", "results": [{"generated_text": "Hello! How can I help you today?", "generated_token_count": 12, "input_token_count": 2, "stop_reason": "eos_token"}]}

use_cases: generate text completions with enterprise foundation models
run chat-style inference against IBM Granite or third-party models
score or classify text with hosted models under IBM governance
embed documents for RAG pipelines in regulated environments
deploy and call fine-tuned models with project-scoped access control
